packages.title: Events, session features and extension events

qualityGates.perWave: merge, refresh pins, all suites green, Linux dry run

wave1.gate: all release suites, Rpc, Sessions, Tools and the four new parity suites green

carryover.item: /reload keeps MCP servers connected and does not re-read mcp.json unless the mcp, codemode or tool-search built-ins changed; upstream reconnects every server on every reload

/reload does not surface re-resolution diagnostics: built-in errors and replacement warnings, package resolution, resources_discover errors, skill/prompt/theme conflicts (interactive shows only Node extension load errors)
built-in replacement (omitReplacedExtensions) considers only Node extensions; a native C# extension registering codemode, tool_search or /mcp does not displace the built-in
JSON nesting depth 1,000 (JsonData.MaximumDepth) where V8's JSON.stringify gives up at about 1,700

the explicit session and rpc verbs keep byte bounds (64 MiB session line/file, 32 MiB RPC record, 8 MiB tool result) and refuse lone surrogates; request bodies 64 MiB and request entries 16 MiB everywhere
get_session_stats fails on non-finite usage where upstream yields NaN (written as null)
models.json schema errors use TypeBox's wording but not its per-branch union errors
websocketConnectTimeoutMs setting not read (Codex WebSocket keeps the 15 s default)

Azure resource names that leave credentials, a fragment or a query in the URL, or a host System.Uri cannot hold, are refused at configuration where upstream fails on the request (decision 0004 item 14)
first-time setup ported but not wired (upstream shows it only with PI_EXPERIMENTAL)

wave2.followUps: IMPL-F (untrusted projects keep tools, MCP trust, rg/fd, Unix bash) and IMPL-H (mid-run MCP publication, in-call waits, step-up sign-in) merged

wave3.followUps: IMPL-I follow-up (live model switching, extension UI, changelog) and IMPL-E rounds 2-3 (real Pi packages, native C# extensions, provider OAuth, reload rebuild, Linux fixes) merged

wave4.burnDown: merged 2026-10-09 (agent-loop boundaries, exact errors, caps removed, session format, Vertex ADC, highlighting, Mermaid); integrity pins refreshed
wave4.reassessment: 2026-10-09: Parity page, website docs, applicability matrix (parity.* rows per package), 1.1.0.2 changelog and release notes

wave5.followUps: issue #5 and thinking clamps; extension/CLI close-out (triggerTurn, setTheme, -e resources, pisharp mcp routing, samples); llama.cpp and native classifier/image providers; Node spawn errors; X11 clipboard; Codex WebSocket and zstd; footer; lone surrogates, 1,000 JSON levels, fractional tokens, JavaScript-string bounds; built-in extensions on/off; auto-compaction in every mode; final leftovers
wave5.reassessment: 2026-10-10: Parity page, website docs, applicability matrix, 1.1.0.3 changelog and release notes; owner decision 14 (Azure resource name)
